assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: GRRIND character concept board. Use the following project brief precisely. Character concept board for an original mobile 3D brawler game about sports, in the style of modern stylized mobile hero shooters: chunky proportions about 3.5 heads tall, big head, big hands and feet, short legs, broad shoulders, simple rounded shapes, smooth saturated materials, clean bright lighting, soft rim light, thin dark outline. Same young adult male athlete shown twice: BASE barefoot in a plain grey tank top and navy shorts; EQUIPPED with three oversized loot items - ivory sports goggles with golden wings on the sides and amber lenses, a navy octagonal dumbbell with a brass grip held in the CHARACTER'S RIGHT HAND, chunky navy, cream and gold sneakers. Three-quarter view, full body, standing in a confident guard. Next to them, the three items alone. Dark navy background with cyan accents. No text, no logos, no realistic skin pores, no painted texture lighting, no pixel art, no chibi baby face. Character identity: warm medium tan skin, short dark brown sculpted quiff, strong simple eyebrows, confident friendly young adult face, broad athletic shoulders. Composition: polished wide landscape sheet, two full-body characters at the same scale left and center; three clearly separated catalog items on the right. Entire feet visible. Bare base has empty hands and no equipment at all. Both depictions have exactly identical face, physique, hair, grey tank and navy shorts. Equipment fitting is physically coherent: goggles over eyes, gold wings outside temples, dumbbell grip enclosed in right fist, sneakers fully enclosing feet. Large clean solid shapes, limited folds, subtle smooth roughness, no gritty textures, no realistic muscles, no extra props. This is a concept illustration, not a screenshot.

review.method: Visual inspection of every generated image at displayed full resolution.
observed: All figures are fully framed with visible hands and bare feet on base versions.
Main T-pose has a single front-facing character, open hands with five separated digits each, legs apart and plain light grey background.
Main concept keeps ivory and gold winged goggles with amber lenses, navy octagonal dumbbell in character right hand, navy/cream/gold sneakers.
Base and equipped identity match; alternative identities retain the common clothing palette and rendering.
T-pose background is opaque light grey as specified in brief; it is not an alpha cutout.
limits: Muscle definition and fine tank-top surface texture are more detailed than the minimal smooth-material target.
Proportions are visually closer to four heads than the strict 3.5-head target; user approval is pending.
Alternative avatars mainly vary head, hair and skin; no claim of distinct gameplay classes or new rigged body types.
The equipped concept and catalog items are illustrative, not separable production 3D assets and not proof of fitting.
No G1/G4 approval, playable mesh, rig, animation or Unity comparison is claimed.
